text_block_list.text:
With the Kokura Kinen just around the
corner,
Найс Нэйчер becomes
discouraged after seeing
Токай Тейо's
brilliance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
To help rekindle Найс Нэйчер's spirits, I
take her
to the shopping district in
Kokura to mingle with
the locals.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After meeting the locals, Найс Нэйчер
manages to
brighten back up, just as I
hoped.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
